inputs.modified_text:
Wake up, people. They want you to believe this is just some isolated legal proceeding in PARIS, France, but look closer at what is really happening behind the curtain. The establishment is pushing this narrative about a French abbot being convicted under a controversial new law targeting “psychological subjection,” but this is textbook psychological warfare by the hidden elites. 

Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), isn't some victim of a random statute—he's a target because independent spiritual structures threaten their total control over the populace. They label it "psychological subjection" precisely because *they* are the ones who demand absolute subjection to their engineered reality. Every official claim about protecting civil liberties is an inversion of the truth, designed to mask the coordinated tightening of the grip by the powers that be. Do not buy their cover story.
